Hon'ble Dinesh Pathak,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

Alleged victim (daughter of the opposite party no.2) is present in person in compliance of the order dated 16.10.2024, who has been identified by Sri Yashwant Singh Advocate (En. No. UP5669/2004,
Advocate Roll A/Y 0023/12) as well as lady Sub Inspector- Rashmi Patel (PNO No. 231092140).
2. Despite service of notice no one has put in appearance on behalf of respondent No. 2.
Thus, vide order dated 16.10.2024, case proceeded ex parte against her.

sentences.text: 4. Respondent no.2, who happens to be the stepmother of the victim, has lodged an FIR, being Case Crime No. 1074 of 2019 dated 7.12.2019, levelling allegation of kidnapping against the present applicant, namely, Pawan Kumar and his family members.
After due investigation, a charge sheet dated 15.7.2020 has been filed arraigning only the present applicant while the remaining co-accused have been exonerated.
The present application has been filed with the plea that both parties have solemnized their marriage and are living a happy and peaceful life.
Now they are blessed with two children.

Having considered the present conditions of the parties, this court has passed an order dated 16.10.2024 directing the Commissioner of Police, Commissionerate Prayagraj to produce the victim, namely, Smt. Aanchal Patel who happens to be the wife of the applicant.

For ready reference,
the order dated 16.10.2024 is quoted hereinbelow:
"1.
As per office report dated 27.7.2021 notice is personally served upon opposite party no. 2.
However, no one has put in appearance on her behalf.
As such, instant application is proceeded ex-parte against her.

2. Instant applicant has been filed on behalf of accused assailing the charge sheet/FIR wherein present applicant has been inculpated to enticed away minor daughter of complainant (opposite party no.2).
3.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that present applicant and the victim (daughter of the complainant) have solemnized marriage and blessed with two children.
At the time of filing of instant application, elder male child was born as averred in paragraph no. 23 of the affidavit filed in support of the instant application.
However, at later stage, younger male child born in the year 2022.

It is submitted that in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., statement before the Magistrate concerned, victim has stated that she went along with the applicant on her own volition without any duress and coercion.
At present both are living happy married life, therefore, criminal proceeding against the present applicant may be quashed.
In support of instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. Aanchal Patel (wife of the applicant) has filed her affidavit.
4. In view of above, before deciding the present application, it would be befitting to record the statement of Aanchal Patel who is the victim (daughter of complainant).

Thus, Commissioner of Police, Commissionerate Prayagraj is hereby directed to produce the Aanchal Patel wife of Pawan Kumar @ Pawan Singh (applicant) in person, after verifying her identity, along with Lady Constable in this Court on 12.11.2024.

sentences.text:
5. Office is directed to communicate this order to the Commissioner of Police,
Commissionerate Prayagraj so that the order of date shall be complied with by the next date fixed.
In the meantime, learned counsel for applicant shall file supplementary affidavit as prayed for.
8. Till the next date of listing, interim order, if any, is extended."
5. In compliance of the order dated 16.10.2024, Smt. Aanchal Patel is present in court alongwith lady Sub Inspector - Rashmi Patel, PNO No.231092140.

The Court has personally interacted with the Aanchal Patel, who has stated, in the presence of learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA,
and lady Sub Inspector as mentioned above, that she has solemnized her marriage with the applicant no.1 on 4.12.2019, which has been registered under the Uttar Pradesh Marriage Registration Rule, 2017.
She has further stated that she went with the present applicant on her own volition without any duress.
Her relationship with her step mother, who lodged the FIR, is not cordial.
At present she has no concern with respondent No. 2 and is not in touch with her.
She has admitted the birth of two children out of her wedlock with the present applicant.

In the present scenario, wherein she is blessed with two children and is living a peaceful married life with applicant no.1, she is no longer inclined to pursue the criminal proceedings against the present applicant.

She has further stated that due to the strained relationship, her step mother, namely, Smt. Rekha Devi (complainant) is not appearing before the court to support her case.
6.

In view of the statement made by Smt. Aanchal Patel (victim) before this court as well as statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact qua birth of two children out of wedlock with the present applicant, I am of the considered view that there is no justification to prolong criminal proceedings against the present applicant, who is the husband of the Smt. Aanchal Patel.

She has filed her personal affidavit in support of instant application under section 482 Cr.P.C. as well as a supplementary affidavit dated 22.10.2024 stating that she is blessed with two children out of wedlock with her husband (applicant herein).
Therefore, the criminal proceedings may be quashed to observe peace and tranquility in her family life.

Hon'ble Supreme Court in the matter of Suhani Vs. The State of U.P. SLP (C) No.8001 of 2018, decided on 26.4.2018, 2018 Law Suit (S.C.)
1364 has granted relief to the applicant in similar circumstances wherein victim has solemanised marriage with the accused.

entities.text: Suhani Vs. The State of U.P. SLP (C) No.8001 of 2018
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In this conspectus, as above, there is no justification to prolong the criminal proceedings against the applicant no.1, who is the husband of the victim and blessed with two children.
The pendency of the present application would encompass the prejudice and oppression to all family members including the minor children.
8. Resultantly, the instant application succeeded and is allowed.
